talking_points: DeepSeek says its refreshed model is faster and cheaper to run, turning up the heat on the global chip-and-inference price war.
Jensen Huang's warning that Nvidia could cut off 'unsafe' AI customers shows chipmakers increasingly see themselves as gatekeepers, not just suppliers.
Franklin Templeton's boss is nervous about the debt piling up to fund AI data centres, echoing wider worries about an AI bubble.
